look_here_first: Start with the unusually colored flower: rose, pink, red, lavender, or occasionally pale petals above glaucous prickly foliage. Confirm Argemone with yellow latex plus prickly buds and capsules.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: large rose, pink, red, lavender, or occasionally pale flowers

lookalikes.differences: Its rose/lavender/reddish petals are a useful clue, but flowers can be WHITE. Confirm with buds having 5–10 mm sometimes basally prickly horns, capsules with short uneven prickles generally 5–7(–10) mm, and upper leaves unarmed or sparingly prickly on main veins. Do not classify every white-flowered plant as A. albiflora or A. polyanthemos.
